title: The satisfying finishing detail
objective: Advertise the homepage's magnetic-cap feature through a clear physical demonstration, then connect it to the existing shopping offer.
casting: One adult Filipino woman, hands and forearms only, demonstrating the white-label Mojito Metallique bottle.
description: The magnetic cap clicks neatly into place. A satisfying finishing touch to your everyday fragrance.
scene: A close-up at a glossy red vanity with golden light. One hand steadies the bottle while the other lifts and replaces its black cap. A small cream hair claw and yellow cuff give the technical feature the same playful lifestyle mood as the scent ads.
styling: Coral manicure and golden-yellow cotton sleeve. Keep the camera below shoulder level. If a mirror edge appears, angle it only toward an empty wall.
props: Actual Mojito bottle and its matching cap, red lacquer surface, cream hair claw, white bounce card. Use a clean lens and wipe fingerprints between takes.
lighting: Raking sunlight or a warm hard key produces a crisp cap highlight. Add soft fill so the black hollow cap underside and silver atomizer remain distinct.
camera: Macro or close focus from just above label height. Keep cap, nozzle and bottle in one focus plane. Shoot the movement at normal speed first; also record a slower insert with the same framing.
performance: Hold the glass firmly with the left hand. Lift the cap straight up with the right, show the small air gap, then lower it gently until it seats. The cap stays physically held until closure; do not stage unsupported hovering.
sound: Record the real cap closure closely in a quiet room. Duck music during the click. Do not replace it with an exaggerated lock, suction or mechanical effect.

A little detail. A lovely finish. The magnetic cap clicks neatly into place—a satisfying finishing touch to your everyday fragrance.

Choose your scents and tap Order Now. #DearBodyPH #AScentJourney
short: 15-second cut: 00–04 shipping offer + cap lifted by hand; 04–06 COD + closed bottle; 06–10 one real closure + MAGNETIC CAP; 10–15 capped hero + ORDER NOW. Voiceover: “Free shipping kapag two items or more. May cash on delivery din. That satisfying magnetic-cap finish. Tap Order Now.”
still: Hold the cap about 2 cm above the nozzle, visibly between fingers, with the other hand supporting the glass body. Show its all-black lower edge and the bottle's silver atomizer. Leave the upper-left surface for offer copy.
continuity: Use the same matched cap and bottle for every take. Preserve black cap edge, correct atomizer and realistic scale. The supported cap and nozzle must stay vertically aligned.
test: Compare opening on a held-open cap with opening on the final click. Keep timing and copy unchanged; measure whether the feature improves product-page visits and orders.
voiceIdentity: Off-screen female narrator: a Filipina woman around 28 years old, with a warm, clear, conversational mid-range voice and smooth natural resonance. She sounds friendly, confident, curious and lightly playful, like a thoughtful friend helping someone choose a personal fragrance. Speak natural conversational Taglish with fluid Tagalog-English code-switching and a natural Filipina accent. Follow the exact supplied Taglish script; do not translate it into all-English or formal Tagalog. Keep scent names and website button labels unchanged. Keep a subtle smile in the voice, crisp diction, gently varied intonation and relaxed conversational pacing. Emphasize product names and key offer conditions clearly. Preserve the same age, accent, pitch range and vocal texture across every shot. Narration is off-screen; do not introduce a talking person or visible mouth. No shouting, forced whispering, exaggerated accent, celebrity imitation or robotic sales cadence.
voiceDirection: Ask the opening buyer question with curiosity, then offer the named scent or brand answer helpfully. Attentive and pleasantly curious. Ease the pace around the cap movement and leave a beat after the click.
fullVoiceover:
Pati details ng perfume bottle, mahalaga sa iyo?

Kilalanin ang Mojito Metallique.

Soft at creamy ang sweetness, may light fruity glow.

Magnetic cap—takip sa spray nozzle, na nagki-click sa puwesto.

Para sa friendly, easygoing, at lighthearted. Puwedeng i-collect at i-display.

Free shipping sa two items or more.

May cash on delivery din. Bagay sa vibe mo? Tap Order Now.
